title: Charger Output Check
description: Validate charger setup and capture stable DC output readings.

steps.title: Inspect Charger Setup
steps.instruction: Confirm the charger is set to the expected output mode before taking measurements.

steps.title: Capture Output Voltage
steps.instruction: Measure the charger output and capture the DC voltage reading.

steps.title: Capture Stability Reading
steps.instruction: Wait for the output to settle, then capture a second DC voltage reading.

steps.title: Record Assessment
steps.instruction: Note whether the charger output appears stable and appropriate for the target device.
